Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the O.P. No.2 and learned APP for the State.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable u/s 406/420 of the IPC.

3. The allegation made out against the petitioner in the complaint petition is that the complainant has given Rs.12,00,000/- to the petitioner for the purchase of a land but neither the land has been purchased nor the aforesaid amount has been returned.
Petitioner is the younger brother of the complainant.
4. Earlier the matter was sent to the Mediation Centre for Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.45682 of 2023(4) dt.16-01-2024 settlement.

A mediation report dated 06.11.2023 is placed on record, in Amit Kumar Singh @ Bittu vs The State Of Bihar on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68021743/
1 which, it is stated that after 2nd, 3rd and 4th sitting of mediation on 04.10.2023, 17.10.2023 and 01.11.2023 respectively, it was agreed by the petitioner that he will pay Rs.4,00,000/- (Rupees Four Lakhs) to the Opposite party no.2 by way of demand drafts, on which the O.P. No.2 was also agreed to withdraw/compromise the Complaint Case No.1504(C) of 2021 but on 06.11.2023, the petitioner took U Turn and said that he will face the trial in Complaint Case No.1504(C) of 2021 and then only he will be bound by and in that view, even after great persuasion, the matter was not finalized.
5.

sentences.text:
Today, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is ready to pay Rs.4,00,000/-
to the O.P. No.2 and he produced a Bank Draft bearing No.935454 dated 04.11.2023, Sr. No.101390 and handed over the same to the counsel appearing for the O.P. No.2 in the Court and a copy of the same is also kept on record.
6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.45682 of 2023(4) dt.16-01-2024 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/Successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No.1504C/2021, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Cr.P.C.
7.
The present application is accordingly disposed of with a direction to the O.P. No.2 to withdraw/compromise the Complaint Case No.1504C/2021 within a period of four weeks from today.

(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) pallavi/-
